description: Story 4.6 — Wrap Engine behavioural-parity smoke fixture. Four vertex indices on the bundled MetaHuman head used as correspondence anchors for both source and target. Target mesh is the same head with a small Y-translation applied via the target Transform; the wrap should produce a uniform displacement close to the offset for both presets.
target_offset_unit_note: Mesh-local units; the bundled MetaHuman head loads in centimetres so 0.5 ≈ 5mm.
test_code_authoritative_note: tests/smoke/wrap_parity.cpp hard-codes these same values for build-time stability — this file documents intent.
